title: AEOS L9 InstructionPatch
description: Payload emitted by DynamicInstructionRuntime.intercept() and consumed by every vendor adapter's invoke() method. Produced by `InstructionPatch.to_dict()` in packages/dynamic_instruction/runtime.py.

additional_instructions.description: Lines of text to prepend to the adapter's system prompt. Each adapter must prepend them with a '[L9 DIR] ' marker so the vendor log can be audited.

restricted_tools.description: Tool names the adapter MUST remove from the candidate tool list before invoking the vendor. Checked against skill.required_tools.

required_tools.description: Tool names the adapter MUST include (idempotent — union with skill.required_tools).

required_citations.description: When true, the adapter must require the vendor to cite source documents in its output. Mock adapters suffix a citation marker to prove the wiring.

require_human_confirmation.description: When true, the adapter (human leg, if hybrid) must block on human confirmation before completing. Surfaced in HumanWorkforceAdapter.trace.dir_human_confirmation_required.

rules_fired.description: The rule_ids that fired to produce this patch. Recorded in the adapter trace and in the ledger row for audit.

safety_envelope.description: An opaque label identifying the safety envelope applied (e.g., 'safety_relevant_v1', 'gdpr_pii_mask_v1'). Used by evidence bundles to group executions by envelope.
